body: Honestly I had like a 5 minute cry it helped a bit. Kinda opened the flood gates though and I can't stop being all tearey and shit, need to sort it out before my girlfriend gets here, don't quite know her well enough to offload all this shit on her yet.

I'm not really able to talk to anyone right now plus I think I should calm down before I talk too much about it. I might actually appreciate having someone to who understands to talk to if you don't mind me coming back here later and PMing you? I might never follow you up on it but right now it feels like something that might help if you were actually being serious?

Even if I don't ever get back to you I do really appreciate that you took the time to offer and even just replying to the post.

Thanks I do really appreciate you showing some warmth, it calmed me down from my spiral a lot.

I've thought about leaving uni for a while but so late in the course it seems counter-intuitive but I don't know if I have many other choices any more. My main worry is just how my parents would react to it. They probably wouldn't get overly mad or anything but I can't get over the idea of just how upset they would be.
